methods.name: RegisterToMethod
methods.description: Register the current connection to a packet stream based on the provided request.

methods.name: UnregisterFromMethod
methods.description: Unregister the current connection from a previously registered subscription.

methods.name: SetTimeInterval
methods.description: Sets a sampling interval for a specific stream. Packets for this stream will only be transmitted if the specified interval (in milliseconds) has elapsed since the last transmission. Setting intervalMs to 0 will disable sampling for the stream.

value.message: Invalid interval or subscription not found
